name: Norton Summit Scenic Lookout Water Tap
notes: Drinking tap near the lookout car park. Bring a bottle; limited supply on race day.

name: Norton Summit Public Toilets
notes: Public toilets in the Norton Summit village near the Scenic Hotel. Expect queues before the peloton passes.

name: Uraidla Oval Drinking Fountain
notes: Drinking fountain beside the oval clubrooms. Close to the stage finish festival area.

name: Uraidla Oval Public Toilets
notes: Clubroom toilets plus extra portable units on race day. Accessible toilet available.

name: Lobethal Main St Water Fountain
notes: Public water fountain and bottle refill on Main Street near the sprint line.

name: Lobethal Main St Public Toilets
notes: Public toilets off Main Street, a short walk from the town centre viewing area.

name: Tanunda Oval Drinking Fountain
notes: Drinking fountain at the recreation park near the oval entrance.

name: Tanunda Oval Public Toilets
notes: Public toilets at the oval and recreation park. Accessible toilet available.

name: Willunga Rose Garden Water Tap
notes: Public water fountain & bottle refill station

name: Willunga Town Square Public Toilets
notes: Public toilets near the town square on High Street. Busy before and after the Willunga Hill stage.

name: Willunga Hill Summit Water Station
notes: Race-day water refill point near the summit spectator zone. No permanent tap; carry water up the climb.

name: Willunga Hill Summit Portable Toilets
notes: Temporary race-day portable toilets at the summit spectator zone. Not available outside event days.

name: Campbelltown Finish Drinking Fountain
notes: Drinking fountain and bottle refill near the finish line precinct.

name: Campbelltown Memorial Oval Toilets
notes: Public toilets at the oval, a short walk from the finish straight. Accessible toilet available.

name: Glenelg Foreshore Water Fountain
notes: Public water fountain & bottle refill on the foreshore near Moseley Square.

name: Glenelg Foreshore Public Toilets
notes: Public toilets on the foreshore by Moseley Square. Accessible toilet and baby change available.
